objective: Recheck the live target, approved source paths, exclusions, and original worktree state before creating an isolated candidate.

acceptedEvidence.claim: The human operator approved isolated candidate construction for the pinned target, 52 included paths, 94 exclusions, and five sanitation gates.
Current committed content and the live remote default are tree-equivalent, so no committed-history transfer is required.

recentFailures.claim: The retained stale packet demonstrates why live ref, commit, and tree coherence must be rechecked from one authority.

allowedReads: Live remote HEAD symref and advertised default-branch SHA

The 52 approved included paths and their recorded hashes
The 94 excluded path names and retention classifications

exclusions: No source, index, branch, remote, or original-worktree mutation

oneFixPlan: Resolve the live target coherently, compare every approved source hash and exclusion against the revision-36 packet, and stop if any overlapping drift or scope mismatch exists.
validationCommand: Repeat live target, source hash, inclusion, exclusion, approval, and zero-mutation checks against an independently regenerated observation.
cancellationRule: Stop on remote drift, source hash drift, missing included paths, unclassified overlap, stale matrix revision, or any requested mutation outside this capsule.
